structured_output.title: Let's Encrypt account key label: issuer usage not shown
structured_output.content: The v1.18.0 note says the account key secrets cert-manager creates for Let's Encrypt now carry the label `app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: cert-manager`. The environment shows cert-manager v1.17.0 and a `cert-manager.io/v1` Certificate manifest. It does not show any Issuer or ClusterIssuer, and the CRD dimension is absent (only certificates.cert-manager.io is listed). So we can't tell whether an ACME/Let's Encrypt issuer exists. If one does, check whether any policy, label selector, backup or cleanup tooling acts on that label or on those account key secrets.
